author: Zephyr I
title: Double-Step LN-ConvLSTM + d=3 bottleneck CNN (late dual-head, AdamW+clip, BASE_SEED=42)
abstract: Test smaller dilation (d=3) with Double-Step LN-ConvLSTM and late dual-head pooling (Attn ⊕ GAP) under AdamW+clip. Fixed hparams; BASE_SEED=42. Goal: compare vs. d=6 winners while changing only dilation.
